headline: Sensex Surges 1,718 Points as Nifty Reclaims 25,000 Level

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: Sensex surged 1,718 points to close at 81,028 while Nifty reclaimed the 25,000 mark.
Indian stocks bucked the global tech rout, posting their best weekly performance in 6 years.
Financial and auto indices led the market rally, climbing up to 4%.
Sliding crude oil prices provided support, helping 10-year Indian bonds post their best week in 7 years.
whatHappening: Nifty 50 closed Samvat 2082 above the 25,000 mark following strong market momentum.
India's foreign exchange reserves declined by $2.69 billion to $717 billion.
Sugar production increased by 9.65 lakh tonnes as 184 mills commenced crushing operations.
SEBI proposed mandatory AML/CFT certification for principal officers of market intermediaries.
summary:
Indian equity benchmarks staged a massive rally with Sensex surging 1,718 points to 81,028 and Nifty crossing 25,000.
Financials and auto stocks spearheaded the gains as domestic markets bucked a global technology sell-off to record their best week in six years.
Bharti Airtel reclaimed the second spot in market capitalization rankings, while Future Retail came under CBI scanner over a fraud case.
